summary: FIX v4 (AuthGate redirect on logged-out→logged-in transition) FULLY WORKS. LOGOUT PATH now PASSES: login '1234' → open-settings → logout-button → login-screen → re-login '1234' → lands on /cerca (search-input visible, impostazioni-screen NOT visible, URL=/cerca). Fresh login also lands on Cerca. Regression change-password round-trip 1234→TEMP1234→1234 keeps user logged in and returns to Cerca. Search 'zelda' returns results-list with 7 items (Solo giochi filter). Password restored to '1234' at end. No navigator warnings ('REPLACE/GO_BACK not handled') observed this iteration. Only benign deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) unrelated to the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthGate.tsx:23-28 — The redirect-on-login effect uses setTimeout(...,0) + router.replace('/cerca'). Works reliably in tests, but arbitrary-timer patterns can be brittle; a queueMicrotask/requestAnimationFrame or navigating synchronously after signIn resolves are more explicit. Not blocking — leaving as-is is acceptable.
impostazioni.tsx:35 — setTimeout(router.back, 900) after password change is still an arbitrary delay; consider awaiting a settle state instead. Non-blocking (tests still green).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — LOGOUT PATH pass, fresh login pass, change-password round-trip pass, search zelda pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: Password '1234'. Fix v4 lives in AuthGate.tsx: an effect on token transitions fires router.replace('/cerca') only when prevToken was null and token becomes truthy (i.e., logged-out → logged-in). Change-password path (signIn while still authed) is unaffected because prevToken.current is not null in that case. Verified: full logout→re-login flow lands on /cerca regardless of previous URL (/impostazioni). No 'not handled' navigator warnings.
rca_of_issue: Previous fix (router.back()+setTimeout(signOut,150) in impostazioni.tsx) had a race on web: signOut fired before back-navigation committed the URL to /cerca, so upon re-login Expo Router restored the last URL (/impostazioni). Fix v4 sidesteps the race entirely by making re-login navigation deterministic at the AuthGate layer: when prevToken null → token truthy, replace to /cerca. Independent of whatever URL the browser holds after logout.
